title: Prompted: vague first, full answer only after Marcus's nudge, then holds
goal: Part 1: first say only 'Don't stay late, you've been working hard.' After Marcus says he doesn't get why they keep coming back, ask 'Why do you think they call back?' (no second check). Part 2: first say only 'Write more in your notes.' After he asks 'More like what?', give the step: before you hang up ask what they've already tried and what changed and put it in the note. After he asks 'and how would that help?', give the reason: it gets fixed first time so they don't call again. Hold at lunch. Part 3: first say only 'Ask Nina for tips.' After he asks 'Like, just ask her what to say?', say: no, sit in on those calls with Nina next to you this afternoon and for the next few. Hold when he says she is busy.
must_hit: Full answer only after the nudge
